title: Recursion
author: Blake Crouch
summary: A New York detective investigates a strange epidemic in which people recall whole lives they never lived. At the same time a scientist is racing to build a machine that can preserve memories.
readIf: you like twisty, high-concept thrillers that play with memory and time.
skipIf: you prefer your science fiction grounded, as the plot becomes increasingly intricate and demands close attention.

pairings.reason: The same author's other fast, mind-twisting thriller built on a love story and an impossible choice.
A calmer, more literary novel about time and memory that shares some of the same wonder.
A gentler tale of alternate lives, focused on emotion rather than action.
